Answer: A
Reason: Comparing the initial chest X-ray (Figure 1a), which shows a large left-sided opacity with mediastinal shift to the left, to the post-treatment image (Figure 1b), there is clear resolution of the mass and opacity. The mediastinum has returned to a more central position (reduced shift), and the left lung fields are aerated, indicating re-expansion of the previously collapsed left lower lobe.
